NV_DOC_CO_CAU_BAI.Mota: The Loner Who Seeks Defeat. An invincible undefeated swordsman who is haunted by solitude as he could not find any opponent

NV_PHONG_THANH_DUONG.Mota: An elderly Mount Hua Sect swordsman, who teaches Ling Hu Chong the formidable skill Nine Swords of Dugu. He lives in solitude like Du Gu Qiu Bai.

NV_TRUONG_TAM_PHONG.Mota: A former Shaolin monk who founded the Wudang Sect and created the Tai Chi Fist. A grand master that no one can compare to, his skills are godlike.

NV_VUONG_TRUNG_DUONG.Mota: A Song Dynasty Taoist who is the strongest in The Five Greats, called Central Divine. He founded Quanzhen Sect.

NV_DONG_PHUONG_BAT_BAI.Mota: The Invincible East who mastered Sunflower Manual. His attacks are too fast, to the point even Ling Hu Chong's Nine Swords of Dugu cannot follow.

NV_TAY_MON_XUY_TUYET.Mota: The white Divine Swordsman, famous for One Strike Ventures West. His being and his sword dissolved into one entity, his body is the sword.

NV_DIEP_CO_THANH.Mota: Nicknamed Sword Immortal, the Lord of White Cloud Castle and a powerful swordsman. He appears cold and unfeeling. His signature skill is Outer Sky's Flying Immortal.

NV_LY_TAM_HOAN.Mota: He was born in a family of scholars and has noble characteristics. His signature weapon is Xiaoli Feidao, No.3 in the Book of Weapons.

NV_QUACH_TUONG.Mota: Guo Jing and Wong Yung's younger daughter. She had a crush on Yang Guo but then she gave up and founded Emei Sect.

NV_VO_NHAI_TU.Mota: One of The Three Xiaodao Elders, Wu Ya Yi is versatile and become a grand master of martial arts. Meet Xu Zhu by chance and gave him all of his internal energy.

NV_QUACH_TINH.Mota: He has mental slowness and honest but he was among The Five Greats.

NV_HU_TRUC.Mota: A kind-hearted monk from the Shaolin Sect. Luckily, he broke a weiqi formation and inherited the inner energy of Wu Ya Zi, become the leader of the Xiaodao Sect.

NV_TIEU_PHONG.Mota: Charismatic leader of the Beggars' Sect who possesses strong leadership, heroic qualities and exceptional prowess in martial arts.

NV_LENH_HO_XUNG.Mota: Disciple of Huashan Sect. He is brave, generous, friendly and kind. Has countless friends everywhere, currently living a carefree reclusive life.

NV_DOAN_DU.Mota: The young and naive Emperor of the Kingdom of Dali. He refuses to learn martial arts but ironically, he acquired many of the strongest skills ever.

NV_DUONG_QUA.Mota: Yang Kang's son and Ou Yang Feng's godson. Yang Guo is the most powerful hero of his age, has a Condor as a companion.

NV_PHUONG_CHAN.Mota: The Abbot of Shaolin. He is highly revered in Kung Fu World for his prowess in martial arts and morally upright characteristics

NV_LAM_TRIEU_ANH.Mota: Founder of the Ancient Tomb Sect. She creates Jade Maiden Manual to defeat Quan Zhen Sword Manual, as her love with Wang Chong Yang failed.

NV_TRUONG_VO_KY.Mota: Zhang Chui San and Yin Su Su's son, godson of Xie Xun. Mastered Nine Yang Manual by chance, become very strong but lives a reclusive life.

NV_CHU_BA_THONG.Mota: Wang Chong Yang's junior, nicknamed Old Imp, his most notable trait is his childish and mischievous personality.

NV_KIM_LUAN_PHAP_VUONG.Mota: Originally a Tibetan lama, he was appointed as Royal Advisor of Mongolia and he represents the Mongols in challenging the Han Chinese Kung Fu World.

NV_CUU_MA_TRI.Mota: Nicknamed Dalun Mingwang (Great Wheel Guardian King), he is an advisor to the Tibetan ruler and a reputable monk from Dalun Monastery.

NV_LUC_TIEU_PHUNG.Mota: Loves to adventure and drink wines, has friends everywhere. He is famous in his martial Lingxi Finger and his facial hair looks like he has 4 eyebrows.

NV_YEU_NGUYET.Mota: First mistress, peerless leader of Yihua Palace. She is beautiful but very cruel. Her martial arts skills are nearly unmatched.

NV_LY_THU_THUY.Mota: Youngest of the Three Xiao Yao Elders. She loves Wu Ya Yi  and conceived a daughter, Li Qingluo, with him. However, Wu Ya Yi does not love Li Qiu Shui.

NV_THACH_PHA_THIEN.Mota: An honest, kind and naive guy now who unintentionally mastered the strongest internal energy and one of the strongest skills in the world.

NV_SO_LUU_HUONG.Mota: Nicknamed Daoshuai (Bandit Chief), he is intelligent and compassionate, only robs the riches to help the poors to uphold justice.

NV_AU_DUONG_PHONG.Mota: One of the Five Greats, known as Western Venom. He created the arts of snakes controling. Later he practiced false Nine Yin Manual and become insane.

NV_TIEU_LONG_NU.Mota: Skin as white as snow, beautiful and elegant beyond convention and cannot be underestimated, but appears cold and indifferent

NV_HOANG_DUOC_SU.Mota: He is one of the Five Greats, known as the East Heretic and Peach Blossom Island's Host. He is the creator of the famous Finger Flicking Skill

NV_HONG_THAT_CONG.Mota: 18th chief of the Beggars' Sect and the Northern Beggar of the Five Greats, nicknamed Nine Fingered Divine Beggar.

NV_NHAT_DANG.Mota: Used to be the King of Dali Empire, he turns to be a monk. His inner energy and medecine are well-known as ones of the best.

NV_DIET_TUYET_SU_THAI.Mota: The dogmatic third leader of the Emei Sect whose name means to destroy and eliminate. She is the reason of Zhou Zhi Ruo's unhappy ending.

NV_NHAM_NGA_HANH.Mota: Leader of the Sun Moon Holy Cult. An expert in martial arts, politics and manipulation, feared by his followers and enemies.

NV_NHAC_BAT_QUAN.Mota: The leader of Huashan sect and its Qi faction, he a bigoted, selfish and power-hungry hypocrite. He castrated himself to learn Bixie Sword Manual.

NV_THIEN_SON_DONG_LAO.Mota: The oldest sister of The Three Xiaodao Elders whose name means Child Old Woman of Mount Heaven. She does as she pleases and brutally control others.

NV_HOANG_DUNG.Mota: Huang Yao Shi's daughter. First female leader of Beggars' Sect. Her charm is unrivaled by any, and a presence so stunning. She is extremely cunning.

NV_VUONG_NGU_YEN.Mota: A goddess-like beautiful and pure young maiden. She has a crush on Mu Rong Fu and tries to memorise all martial arts manuals to help Murong Fu

NV_TU_SAM_LONG_VUONG.Mota: One of 4 Ming Cult Guardians King, nicknamed Purple Dress Dragon King, she is a beautiful woman hiding from the Persian Ming Cult

NV_YEN_NAM_THIEN.Mota: Nicknamed Best Divine Swordsman Under Heaven. He is one of the most powerful martial artists that his swordsman aura can be even felt from afar.

NV_THUONG_QUAN_KIM_HONG.Mota: Evil leader of the Jin Qian Bang, is the No.1 in the Book of Weapons, means that he is the strongest. Regarded as King of Kung Fu World

NV_HO_NHAT_DAO.Mota: A legendary hero from Liaodong. He was highly respected not only for his prowess in martial arts, but also for his gregarious character.

NV_MIEU_NHAN_PHUONG.Mota: A formidable martial artist, nicknamed Golden Faced Buddha. He forged a close friendship with Hu Yidao. His daughter Miao Ruolan marries Hu Fei.

NV_VIEN_THUA_CHI.Mota: A fine young hero, he strives to uphold justice and defend his native land from foreign invasion. In the end, he left China and sailed to a distant land.

NV_HO_PHI.Mota: Son of Hu Yi Dao, one of the four bodyguard families of Li Zi Cheng, he inherited his family's Hu Family Blade Techniques.

NV_KIM_XA_LANG_QUAN.Mota: A both good and bad man. His devotion for his love is unmatched: after his lover betrayed him, he ran away with her, killing a lot of masters while poisoned.

NV_THANH_CON.Mota: Nicknamed Hunyuan Thunderbolt Hand. He killed Xie Xun's family in cold blood. Finally he plots to dominate the Kung Fu World.

NV_CHU_CHI_NHUOC.Mota: Beautiful, pure and free of worldly traits, and the 4th leader of Emei. She is strong but still has her weak and soft side. She loves Zhang Wu Ji deeply.

NV_VI_TIEU_BAO.Mota: Witty, sly and illiterate man. He makes a number of seemingly impossible achievements through sheer luck and wit, finally lives happily with seven wives.

NV_HOA_MAN_LAU.Mota: One of Lu Xiaofeng's close friends. He is intelligent, skilled in martial arts and have vast knowledge of almost everything

NV_NHAM_DOANH_DOANH.Mota: Ren Wo Xing's daughter. Intelligent and caring but can be ruthless and cold blooded at times.  She leads a reclusive life with Ling Hu Chong.

NV_TIEU_CHIEU.Mota: Daughter of Purple Dress Dragon King and a spy servant in Zhang Wu Ji's household. She is beautiful from her personality to her appearance.

NV_HOANG_SAM_NU_TU.Mota: A beautiful and strong maiden, who appears to help Zhang Wuji in times of danger and saved Xie Xun's life. She is a descendant Yang Guo and Xiaolongnu.

NV_A_PHI.Mota: Nicknamed Flying Swordsman, a young and haughty swordsman. His weapon is just a metal stick covered in a roll of clothes, but it is deadly in his hand.

NV_LAM_PHUONG_HOANG.Mota: Her name means Blue Phoenix, she's the leader of the Five Immortals Cult. She cured Ling Hu Chong of his internal injuries and become his godsister

NV_MO_DUNG_PHUC.Mota: A descendant of a fallen royal family. An egoistic, scheming and ruthless man, he resorts to all sorts of methods to revive his family's legacy.

NV_GIAC_VIEN.Mota: Taking care of Shaolin's Scripture Library, he's a pedantic Shaolin monk with extremely powerful internal energy and Zhang Jun Bao's master.

NV_CUU_THIEN_NHAN.Mota: Leader of the Iron Palm Sect, nicknamed Iron Palm Skimming on Water for his prowess in martial arts and qinggong.

NV_KHO_VINH.Mota: Renowned monk of Tianlong Temple, highly regarded in both martial arts and virtue

NV_KINH_VO_MENH.Mota: Unfeeling Swordmaster's Successor. Appears cold and unfeeling, he does everything for Shang Guan Jin Hong.

NV_PHO_HONG_TUYET.Mota: From the Demon Sect, he suffers from epilepsy and has a disabled right leg. He appears cold and unfeeling but has powerful exponent in the use of the Blade.

NV_LY_TU.Mota: Evil messenger from Heroes' Island. Sworn brother of Shi Po Tian.

NV_TRUONG_TAM.Mota: Good messenger from Heroes' Island. Sworn brother of Shi Po Tian.

NV_HOA_VO_KHUYET.Mota: Xiao Yu Er's twin brother. He is the heir to Yihua Palace and its only male resident. He is kind, vitued and handsome, also a strong martial artist.

NV_TIEU_NGU_NHI.Mota: Raised by the Five Great Villains, but he is actually soft-hearted and kind. He possesses strong charms and rugged good looks.

NV_MAI_SIEU_PHONG.Mota: A disciple of Huang Yao Shi, stole Nine Yin Manual and learned Nine Yin White Bone Claw. She is blind due to being ambushed.

NV_LAM_BINH_CHI.Mota: The sole survivor in a massacre of his family. To take revenge, he castrated himself to pratice Bixie Sword Manual.

NV_MAI_HOA_DAO.Mota: A mysterious assassin whose victims have apricot-shaped injuries.

NV_A_TU.Mota: Ah Zhu's younger sister and a disciple of Ding Chun Qiu. She is sadistic and cruel. She has a crush on Xiao Feng and followed suit after he took his own life.

NV_A_CHAU.Mota: The eldest daughter of Duan Zheng Chun. She is very skilled in the art of disguise. A Zhu loved Xiao Feng but was mistakenly killed by him.

NV_TU_KHONG_TRICH_TINH.Mota: He is highly skilled in martial arts and specialized in the art of thieving and disguise.

NV_TRIEU_MAN.Mota: A princess, Zhang Wu Ji's true love. Naturally elegant, ambitious and full of vigour. She decided to live a reclusive life with her lover.

NV_DUONG_TIEU.Mota: Bright Left Ambassadors of Ming Cult, he serves as the cult's acting leader during the period of internal conflicts.

NV_PHAM_DAO.Mota: Bright Right Ambassadors of Ming Cult. He disfigures himself as a mute monk to find Cheng Kun.

NV_KIM_MAO_SU_VUONG.Mota: One of 4 Ming Cult Guardians King, nicknamed Golden Haired Lion King, he has golden hair, a huge stature, hot temper and profound knowledge.

NV_LY_MAC_SAU.Mota: Disciple of Ancient Tomb Sect. Although she is beautiful but she became cold-blooded killer having strong martial arts after her lover betrayed her.

NV_THANH_DUC_BUC_VUONG.Mota: One of 4 Ming Cult Guardians King, nicknamed Blue Winged Bat King, he drinks warm bloods to keep the icy venom in his body under control.

NV_BACH_MI_UNG_VUONG.Mota: One of 4 Ming Cult Guardians King, nicknamed White Brows Eagle King, he's Zhang Wu Ji's maternal grandfather.

NV_DOAN_CHINH_THUAN.Mota: 15th emperor of the Kingdom of Dali, younger brother of Duan Zheng Ming. Many legendary beauties are all his lovers.

NV_LIEN_TINH.Mota: Second mistress of Yihua Palace and Yaoyue's younger sister. A sweet and pretty woman, she saved the twins' lives and treats Hua Wu Que like his mother would.

NV_QUACH_PHU.Mota: Guo Jing and Wong Yung's elder daughter. Though beautiful and attractive in appearance, she is spoiled by her parents and behaves insolently.

NV_DU_THAN_CHI.Mota: You Tan Zhi's life is a tragedy. His parents died when he was young. Ah Zi forces him to have an iron mask welded onto his head to conceal his identity.

NV_TONG_VIEN_KIEU.Mota: A reputable swordsman, he is disgraced by his son's misconduct and loses the opportunity to be Wudang's new leader.

NV_DINH_XUAN_THU.Mota: Nicknamed Xing Xiu Lao Guai, head of Xing Xiu Sect, known for his mastery with poisons, as well as his treachery and deception.

NV_TA_LANH_THIEN.Mota: The ambitious and ruthless leader of the Mount Song Sect and chief of the alliance. He practises Freezing Inner Energy.

NV_HA_TUC_DAO.Mota: Nicknamed Kunlun Three Sage. He loves Guo Xiang very much but she did not return his feeling. So he chooses to lead the Kunlun Sect.

NV_NHAC_LINH_SAN.Mota: The pretty, teenage daughter of Yue Bu Qun, she was Linghu Chong's first romantic interest. She falls in love with Lin Pingzhi later and marries him.

NV_MA_NGOC.Mota: Wang Chong Yang's first disciple, having strong martial arts. He is very generous and oftens help people.

NV_HUYET_DAO_LAO_TO.Mota: An evil monk with a Bloody Blade. He does not hide his evil and loudly says that he is evil.

NV_NGHI_LAM.Mota: A beautiful nun who falls in love with Ling Hu Chong but she has to suppress her feelings because she is forbidden by her vow of celibacy.

NV_THIET_TAM_LAN.Mota: A beautiful girl who begged Hua Wu Que to die to save Xiao Yu Er. She's entangled in a love triangle between them and finally chose Hua Wu Que.

NV_DOAN_CHI_BINH.Mota: Senior student of Quanzhen and Third Leader of Quanzhen Sect.

NV_DUONG_KHANG.Mota: Sworn brother of Guo Jing. Tragically, lured by promises of wealth and luxury, he got a tragic end. He loves Mu Nianci and fathered Yang Guo.

NV_HAI_DAI_PHU.Mota: An old eunuch who previously served the Shunzhi Emperor.

NV_TO_ANH.Mota: Arrogant, beautiful and indifferent girl. Well-versed in medicine and extremely cunning. Truly love Xiao Yu Er with all her heart.

NV_VUONG_BAT_SUY.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_MA_PHU_NHAN.Mota: Deputy chief of the Beggar's Sect's wife.

NV_KHA_TRAN_AC.Mota: He's 1st brother of the Seven Freaks of Jiangnan, nicknamed Flying Bat, he's blinded.

NV_LINH_TRI_THUONG_NHAN.Mota: A Tibetan monk who poisons Wang Chu Yi in a fight.

NV_DINH_BAT_TU.Mota: A bad guy who have delusions of his power.

NV_BO_DAI_HOA_THUONG.Mota: Nicknamed Monk with the Sack, one of Five Wanderers of Ming Cult

NV_PHONG_BA_AC.Mota: A obstinate person but definite about good and evil.

NV_LUU_CHINH_PHONG.Mota: Borned in a famous family, interested in prosody and musical instrument.

NV_KHAU_XU_CO.Mota: Taoist name Changchunzi, one of Seven Immortals of Quanzhen. He is the strongest in the Seven Immortals, helped Yang and Guo families many times.

NV_LAO_THUC_HOA_THUONG.Mota: He get often consulted for advice in solving mysteries. He is said to be a very honest person and speaks the truth all the time as his name.

NV_VUONG_XU_NHAT.Mota: Taoist name Yu Yang Zi, one of Seven Immortals of Quanzhen. He is the second strongest in the Seven Immortals

NV_CHU_NGU_THU.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_BINH_NHAT_CHI.Mota: A physician nicknamed Famous Killer Physician. He makes a rule that for every life he saves, another must die.

NV_TIEN_NHI_BAI.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_LY_TU_TOI.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_TOAN_QUAN_THANH.Mota: One of 4 Beggars's Elders. Nicknamed All Rounded Scholar, was seduced by Kang Min and instigated by her to incite his fellows to rebel against Qiao Feng

NV_BAO_BAT_DONG.Mota: Generous and frank, he finds it hardest to confess his faults.

NV_DIEN_BA_QUANG.Mota: With both an outstanding swift and blade stance, he's a man of lust and widely recognized as a philanderer.

NV_TO_TINH_HA.Mota: Founder of the Deaf Mute Sect, he indulged in various types of arts and neglected his martial arts practice.

NV_THACH_TRUNG_NGOC.Mota: A spoiled youngster who only knows cheating and wooing women. He is the opposite of his heroic twin brother.

NV_DIEP_NHI_NUONG.Mota: One of The Four Evils, nicknamed Commits all Kinds of Evil. She is notorious for kidnapping babies. She is Xu Zhu's mother.

NV_HAC_BUT_ONG.Mota: 2nd brother of Xuanming Elders. He has a penchant for fine wine. His weapon is a metal pen.

NV_AU_DUONG_KHAC.Mota: Ou Yang Feng's illegitimate son. A lecherous fiend, he enjoys preying on young and beautiful maidens, especially Huang Rong, Mu Nianci and Cheng Yaojia.

NV_TRINH_THAT_DIET.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_LUC_DAI_HUU.Mota: Nicknamed Sixth Monkey, Yue Bu Qun's sixth student. He stole Violet Mist Divine Skill manual to help Ling Hu Chong recover from his injuries.

NV_GIANG_NGOC_LANG.Mota: The son of Jiang Bie He, an expert in charming and seducing women. He is very cunning and many times nearly tricked and killed Xiao Yu Er.

NV_TRIEU_CHI_KINH.Mota: The most senior of all Quanzhen students whose average martial arts. He was Yang Guo's master when the latter was in Quanzhen.

NV_TONG_THANH_THU.Mota: Song Yuan Qiao's son, he betrays the Wudang Sect and reluctantly joins the Beggars' Sect. Ke killed his uncle for a girl.

NV_TIEU_ME_ME.Mota: One of The Ten Great Villains. She is a notorious criminal who uses her beauty to enslave young men and mistreat them.

NV_LONG_TIEU_VAN.Mota: Kind and heroic looking, but from the inside he is treacherous, selfish. Finally he stole the fiancee of his sworn brother for an unhappy ending.

NV_KHUC_DUONG.Mota: An elder of the Sun Moon Holy Cult, has passion for music.

NV_CAP_CAP_NHI.Mota: One of Ten Great Villains. His appearance is kind, but he is evil inside.

NV_KIM_CUU_LINH.Mota: Chief of Lufei Gate, he works for the government but infact he is a criminal from his core.

NV_TRAN_HUU_LUONG.Mota: Served as an Eight Pouches Elders of the Beggars Sect but working as a spy for Cheng Kun.

NV_HAN_THIEN_DIEP.Mota: Zi Shan Long Wang's husband. He disappeared from the Kung Fu World for too long and no one knows where he is anymore.

NV_BACH_HIEU_SINH.Mota: The author of Bingqipu - Book of Weapons. He has great knowledge of many weapons and write their power into a book.

NV_NGO_LUC_PHA.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_LAO_DUC_NAC.Mota: Nicknamed Old Man Sa, Yue Bu Qun's second student but actually a spy sent by Zuo Leng Shan to steal the Violet Mist Divine Skill Manual.

NV_TRIEU_NHAT_THUONG.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_TON_TAM_HUY.Mota: One of the Divine Arrow Eight Heroes of Ruyang Palace.

NV_THIET_CHIEN.Mota: One of Ten Great Villain. Nickname Mad Lion, he loves his daughter and fighting randomly very much.

NV_AN_LE_DINH.Mota: 6th disciple of Zhang San Feng, very skillful in swordsmanship.

NV_GIANG_BIET_HAC.Mota: He was brutal and ruthless by nature, but was intelligent and capable as well.

NV_VAN_TRUNG_HAC.Mota: One of The Four Evils, nicknamed Thoroughly Cruel, Utterly Evil, armed with an iron staff, he is a is a lecherous fiend who preys on young women.

NV_DO_SAT.Mota: Nicknamed Blood Hands, one of Ten Great Villain.

NV_NAM_HAI_NGAC_THAN.Mota: One of The Four Evils, nicknamed Ferocious Deity and Evil Devil, armed with a pair of giant scissors, he often threatens to kill people by breaking their necks.

NV_LOC_TRUONG_KHACH.Mota: 1st brother of Xuanming Elders. A lecherous fiend who is after young women. He lusts for Lady Han and Zhou Zhiruo. His weapon is a bar with a deer-shaped head.

NV_HUONG_VAN_THIEN.Mota: An elder of Sun Moon Holy Cult, a person with a disposition to do good.

NV_DUONG_LIEN_DINH.Mota: Dongfang Bubai's male lover. Got captured by Ren Wo Xing to force Dongfang Bubai from fighting and is the reason why the invincible Dong Fang Bu Bai lost.

NV_AM_CUU_U.Mota: A half-ghost half-human, one of Ten Great Villain.

NV_AN_TO_TO.Mota: Daughter of the founder of Heavenly Eagle Cult, Yin Tian Zheng and wife of Zhang Cui Shan.

NV_LY_DAI_CHUY.Mota: One of Ten Great Villain who eat human.

NV_VAN_XUAN_LUU.Mota: A physician at Villains' Valley, he just stays there because he does not like the society. He is a good person and treat Xiao Yu Er like his son. He saved Yan Nan Tian
